outcome.technical: WHAT CHANGED. (1) .github/actions/browser-install/action.yml (new composite action) holds the install once; browser-panel and browser-report call it, and the two inline copies are deleted from ci.yml. Its steps: npm ci; pins (playwright-core pin, ImageOS, arch, BROWSER_CACHE_VERSION=1; the image version is logged, not keyed); naming the packages the image lacks; seed-only lookups (actions/cache/restore lookup-only) and a decide step; restore and install of the browser; restore of the system packages' set (debs/ plus lists/, the apt index they were resolved against); and the install step. The install step asks apt `--print-uris` against the set's own index what the install lacks. That covers named packages and dependencies, and a wrong-size file, which apt deletes and queues again (acquire-item.cc pkgAcqArchive::QueueNext). Only those files are fetched; no index is fetched on a hit. If the install from the set still fails, the step falls back once to a fresh fetch with a ::warning:: naming BROWSER_CACHE_VERSION, and it is red only when that also fails. (2) SEEDING. On a push to main whose commit is already verified, the browser jobs are no longer skipped. Their `if:` is now `!cancelled()`, they call the action with seed=(verified output non-empty), and their slice step carries `if: needs.verified.outputs.run == ''`. In seed mode the action installs nothing when both entries exist, and otherwise installs and saves under main's scope. No new job, no dispatch input, no --exempt-job change. (3) tools/gate-parity.py: job_slices now reads the `if:` of the step carrying a verify.sh call, the same way it reads a job's (`_step_runs`, `_call_tier`). New cases: sv21 (allow: a step guarded by verified's output), sv22 (an unprovable step condition is a finding and its slices are not counted as run), sv23 (a release-only step makes its slices release-only). The docstring and comment lines saying every CI job is setup plus one verify.sh call now say every job that runs a gate. (4) Bounds, by the file's rule, from the longest finished run after the change: longest browser-panel 7m46s and browser-report 13m35s (both run 44385960921). The report's bound moves 26 to 28 (2x 13m35s = 27m10s). The panel's moves 16 to 18, inside its 15m32s to 23m18s range, to hold its slowest measured miss: 14m49s, run 42283005055. (5) CONTRIBUTING.md :180-185 and :210-224 describe the shape: verified is the one job running no slice, and on a verified push the browser jobs seed without their slice. THREE DEFECTS THE FIRST PROBE FOUND, and their fixes. (a) The install failed on every runner with `mkdir: cannot create directory .../lists/partial: Permission denied`, because GNU `cp -a src/. dst/` gave dst root's owner and a runner-user mkdir followed. Fix: every write to the set goes through sudo; the index is copied with `cp -p "$sys_lists"*_*` (files only); one chown hands the set to the runner user at the end. (b) The key named the image version. The probe's jobs landed on 20261111.370.1, 20261116.376.1 and 20261111.127.1 with one package-list hash, so the seed covered only its own image. Fix: key = chromium-sysdeps-<ImageOS>-<arch>-<hash>-v<BROWSER_CACHE_VERSION>, no restore-keys. (c) jc0 went red (`verified` no longer ran alone) because the seed was a job of its own. Fix: the seeding moved into the browser jobs, as above; verified is alone again, with counts 16 per run and 17 on the release tier. STAGE-TWO PROBE (fc7abaf3, ci/P169-seed-probe2), read from the logs myself. Run 44385960921, miss: the panel job (image 20261111.127.1) logged `Fetched 13.2 MB in 14s (937 kB/s)` and `Fetched 21.1 MB in 1min 31s (232 kB/s)`, about 2m20s of install, and saved both keys. The report job fetched at 20.5 MB/s; its saves logged `Unable to reserve cache` (the panel job saved first). Run 44388480667, hit: both jobs logged `Cache restored from key` for both keys (browser ~266 MB, system packages ~63 MB). The panel job was on 20261111.370.1, not the image that saved the entry, and logged `the restored set holds every file the install needs...`. The hit step has no Get: and no Fetched line in either job (88 lines from that line to the slice, counted). Install took about 20s in the panel job and 48s in the report job; the report's 35s after the restore is local, apt `Reading package lists...` 18s plus dpkg `Reading database` about 10s. No Permission denied, ::warning:: or ::error:: in any of the four logs. Each run concluded failure on vt8 (tests/test__commit_trail.py) and on pgo7 in run 2, neither in my files. STUB HARNESS (scratchpad stubs/, not committed): 20/20 on the tree. Cases: si1 full hit; si2 miss; si3 named package missing; si4 dependency missing; si5 truncated .deb (apt's size check makes it a partial fetch, not a fallback); si6 unreadable same-size .deb (the fallback runs once and passes); si7 stale index (fallback once, passes); si8 fallback failing (red); si9 miss with the archive down; si10 ownership; old1/old2 (HEAD's step: a dependency missing means dpkg refuses after `no archive is asked`, and one package missing re-fetches the index and every file); sp1-sp6 the seed decision; sk1/sk2 the key. si10 and sk1 are red on 49a34e63's action. Mutations M1-M7 are each red in their own cases. The harness's limits: its sudo is not root, so ownership is a ledger model; it models only the GNU semantics it was given (cp -a with src/.); it cannot see the _apt sandbox user, sudo's env reset, file modes beyond the owner, dpkg locks or triggers, apt's real resolver, or the cache action itself. THE KEY TRADE: without the image version, a job on any image of the distribution restores the entry. When images differ, apt answers against the set's index: a dependency the image lacks is fetched alone. If two images need different versions of one dependency, an installed version the index satisfies costs nothing; one it cannot satisfy, or a file the archive dropped, falls back once with a warning. That fallback repeats on every run of that image until the key moves (package list or BROWSER_CACHE_VERSION), because an entry is never overwritten. The set's index ages with the entry until a key change or a week-long eviction.
outcome.descriptive: The browser install is written once, a hit asks the archive for nothing on any image version of the distribution, main's verified pushes seed the caches, and the install works as root on a real runner; measured once: install about 20s on a hit against about 2m20s on a miss at 232 kB/s.
